SELECT sf.id, sf.name, sf.phone, sf.account, sf.role, sf.title, sf.menu_permissions AS menuPermissions, sf.status, sf.campus_id AS campusId, cp.name AS campusName, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM class_group cg WHERE cg.teacher_id = sf.id) AS classCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schedule s WHERE s.teacher_id = sf.id) AS scheduleCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM class_comment cc WHERE cc.teacher_id = sf.id) AS commentCount FROM staff sf LEFT JOIN campus cp ON cp.id = sf.campus_id
ORDER BY sf.status DESC, sf.id
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(sf.status = 1), 0) AS active, COALESCE(SUM(sf.role = 'teacher'), 0) AS teachers, COALESCE(SUM(sf.role = 'consultant'), 0) AS consultants FROM staff sf
